risks.proof: A photo showing the gearbox coupled to or sitting beside the claimed 20hp electric motor, with motor nameplate visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gearbox only, no motor included.

risks.risk: Gear ratio could be different from the claimed 1:10
risks.proof: Close-up, legible photo of the nameplate showing ratio, brand, and model.

risks.risk: Internal wear, gear/bearing condition, oil leaks, or seized shaft cannot be assessed from a static photo
risks.proof: A video of the output shaft being turned by hand or under load, and photo of oil level/drain plug.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional / unverified condition (worst case).

risks.risk: Brand and manufacturer unknown, which strongly affects resale value for industrial gear units
risks.proof: Readable close-up of the nameplate (brand, model, serial, input/output speed, torque rating).

proof_requests: Clear, in-focus close-up of the nameplate on the gearbox (brand, model, ratio, torque/power rating).
A photo or video clearly showing the claimed 20hp electric motor, including its own nameplate.
A video of the gearbox output shaft being rotated by hand to show it is not seized.
A photo showing the mounting flange/coupling to confirm motor-gearbox compatibility and that both are included as one lot.
